200.description: Returns the queued message, including its delivery attempts and last error.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

source.description: How this message entered the queue

enumDescriptions.smtp: Submitted through the built-in SMTP server

source.title: OutboxSource

gateway.description: Gateway ID used for delivery, or null when no gateway is set

proxy.description: Proxy URL used for delivery, or null when no proxy is set

localAddress.description: Local IP address used for delivery, or null when not set

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key provided when the message was submitted

useStructuredFormat.description: Whether this message is sent to MS Graph as structured JSON instead of raw MIME

created.description: When this message was added to the queue

anyOf.description: Next delivery attempt time (approximate, computed from the retry backoff without jitter). False when all delivery attempts have been used up
anyOf.title: OutboxNextAttempt

attempts.description: Maximum delivery attempts before marking as failed

state.description: Where the message is in the queue

enumDescriptions.delayed: Waiting for its scheduled time, or for the backoff before its next delivery attempt
enumDescriptions.waiting: Ready to be delivered as soon as a submit worker is free
enumDescriptions.active: A delivery attempt is running right now
enumDescriptions.failed: Every delivery attempt failed, or the receiving server rejected the message for good. Listed while the job record is retained, and retryable while its content is

state.title: OutboxState

enumDescriptions.queued: Accepted and waiting for a delivery attempt
enumDescriptions.processing: A submit worker has picked the message up
enumDescriptions.smtp-starting: Opening the SMTP connection to the destination
enumDescriptions.smtp-completed: The SMTP transaction finished and the message was handed over
enumDescriptions.submitted: Delivered to the receiving server. Later bounces arrive as webhooks
enumDescriptions.error: Delivery failed. See the error field for the reason and whether it will be retried

response.description: SMTP server response (when status is "submitted" or "smtp-completed")

messageId.description: Message-ID header value of the sent message (when status is "smtp-completed")

originalMessageId.description: Original Message-ID header value if the server assigned a new one (when status is "smtp-completed")

responseCode.description: The SMTP reply code when the receiving server answered. A 5xx other than 503 is a permanent rejection that is not retried

networkRouting.description: Network routing information for the failed delivery attempt (when status is "error")
networkRouting.title: OutboxErrorNetworkRouting

400.description: Invalid input - the path parameters, query arguments, or request payload did not pass validation. Also returned when the email server refused the request, in which case the response carries a code and the server response instead of a field list

fields.description: List of input fields that failed validation

message.example: "pageSize" must be less than or equal to 1000

key.description: Name of the input field that failed validation

path.description: Full path of the input field that failed validation. Same as key for a top-level field, dotted for a nested one

fields.title: ValidationErrorFields

details.description: Additional error details, if available. The email server response for a refused mailbox operation

info.description: Additional error details, if available. The email server response for a refused message operation

401.description: Authentication failed - the access token is missing, invalid, or was not accepted

403.description: Access denied - the access token does not grant permission for this operation (token scope, account, or IP address restriction)

requestedScope.description: The scope the operation needed, when the token does not carry it

requiredPermission.description: The permission grant the operation needed, when the token permissions do not include it

remoteAddress.description: The client IP address, when the token is restricted to other addresses

404.description: Not found - the requested entity (account, message, mailbox, etc.) does not exist

429.description: Rate limit exceeded - too many requests were made with this access token

ttl.description: Seconds until the rate limit window resets

500.description: Internal server error - an unexpected error occurred while processing the request
